text: Figure 7.2: Service-Oriented Communication Service Discovery decides whether external and internal service-oriented communi- cation is established. The discovery strategy shall allow either returning a specific service instance or all available instances providing the requested service at the time of the request, no matter if they are available locally or remote. The Communication Management software should provide an optimized implementation for both the Ser- vice discovery and the communication connection, depending on the location where the service provider resides. More about Service Discovery can be found in SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol Specification [6]. The service class is the central element of the Service-Oriented Communication pat- tern applied in Adaptive AUTOSAR. It represents the service by collecting the methods and events which are provided or requested by the applications implementing the con- crete service functionality .
